author: KingOfSwordArts
body: I recently got banned on your server, for many reason one reason is hacking another reason is ban evading . I have made a bad decision, I now understand that hacking is'nt aloud on your server and then I break the rules.. ive made a poor decision and deserved to be punished and which was my ban. I understand that freedom is precious freedom comes from responsibility and that was my lack of responsibility. Most importantly I would'nt hack or break the rules on your server again if I do, I have to serve the punishment and consiquences.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hey KingOfSwordArts
We have a strict no appeal policy for ban evading which is rarely broken
In this case you have ban evaded today , which is not acceptable and you should know that it is not allowed.

For this reason your appeal is denied

I will lock in 24 hours or once requested 
~Pizza
